security_audit.summary: Two command findings are confirmed because the skill directs agents to execute connector scripts outside the audited package, which also initiate network searches. The other 26 alerts are Markdown fences, documentation links, local output paths, or harmless metadata references, and no semantic threat was found.

remediation.issue: The live-search instructions execute connector scripts that are outside the audited skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle and review the connector scripts, or use a host-approved search tool with explicit user consent before network access.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the shell commands or declare the required command and network capabilities so users can make an informed installation decision.

content.user_title: Analyze SERPs and Find Ranking Opportunities
content.value_statement: Search results change by query, location, device, and time. This skill turns live or supplied SERP evidence into prioritized ranking and content recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Maps organic results, AI Overviews, snippets, People Also Ask, media packs, local packs, ads, and related searches.
Compares top-ranking pages by format, authority, freshness, links, structure, and likely ranking factors.
Identifies dominant search intent using visible SERP features and result types as evidence.
Calculates a weighted difficulty score and explains fit for new, growing, and established sites.
Recommends content requirements, outlines, snippet formats, AI citation opportunities, and next actions.
Compares multiple keywords, locations, devices, or historical SERP observations.
limitations: Feature analysis requires a current screenshot or direct SERP access; organic search APIs may omit visible modules.
Authority, backlink, and traffic metrics require supplied exports or connected SEO tools.
Historical comparisons require dated screenshots, exports, or another reliable archive.
Difficulty scores are estimates unless every weighted input comes from measured data.

use_cases.title: Plan a competitive article
use_cases.description: Identify the format, depth, evidence, and SERP features a new article must address.

use_cases.title: Prioritize SEO targets
use_cases.description: Compare candidate queries by intent, ranking barriers, volatility, and site-stage fit.

use_cases.title: Find AI visibility opportunities
use_cases.description: Review AI Overview citations, answer formats, video results, and structured content opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one query
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the current SERP for [keyword] in [location] on [device]. Identify intent, visible features, top-result formats, and three practical opportunities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a focused SERP snapshot.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate supplied evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these SERP screenshots or URLs for [keyword], compare the top results. Explain ranking patterns, content requirements, and feature opportunities with evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when direct search access is unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Compare keyword SERPs
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare SERPs for [keyword 1], [keyword 2], and [keyword 3] in [location]. Highlight overlap, intent differences, difficulty, and the best target.

prompt_templates.title: Run a multi-market audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [keyword] across [locations] and [devices], then compare current and historical evidence. Score difficulty, volatility, site-stage fit, and AI visibility opportunities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Support advanced market and platform planning.

output_examples.input: Analyze the SERP for project management software using the supplied desktop screenshot.
output: Intent: Commercial investigation, supported by comparison pages, vendor pages, ads, and review results.
Primary opportunity: Publish a transparent comparison with pricing, use cases, limitations, and an updated evaluation method.
Evidence status: Screenshot observations are user-provided; backlink requirements remain unavailable.

output_examples.input: Compare local SERPs for emergency plumber in Bristol and Bath.
output: Both markets show strong local intent through map packs and service pages.
Bristol appears more competitive because established directories and larger providers occupy more visible positions.
Recommended focus: Build location-specific service proof, review coverage, and complete business profile information.

best_practices: Provide the target location, language, device, date, and current SERP evidence.
Label every metric as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.
Support intent and difficulty conclusions with specific features and ranking pages.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a generic organic result API as a complete view of SERP features.
Do not present estimated authority, links, traffic, or difficulty inputs as measured facts.
Do not reuse one market's SERP conclusions for another location, device, or date.

faq.question: Does this skill discover keyword demand?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates results for known queries. Use keyword research tools to discover demand and search volume.

faq.question: What input produces the strongest analysis?
faq.answer: Provide the query, location, language, device, date, and a current screenshot or top-result list.

faq.question: Can it analyze AI Overviews?
faq.answer: Yes, when the supplied or live SERP shows the overview, citations, and answer structure.

faq.question: Can it compare mobile and desktop results?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply evidence for both devices so the analysis can compare features, ordering, and opportunities.

faq.question: How is difficulty calculated?
faq.answer: The score weights top-result authority, page links, content quality, backlink needs, and SERP stability.

faq.question: Does it guarantee rankings?
faq.answer: No. It identifies observed requirements and opportunities, but algorithms, competitors, and results can change.
